comparison.objective: Clock an open shell 90 degrees around a held shaft in mid-air; candidate adjusts a damper collar and tests stopping behavior.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanually hold one body while orbiting another to a relative angle versus tool-mediated unlocking, collar rotation, relocking and guarded cycling.
comparison.success_condition: Measured 90-degree relative pose with both bodies clear of the table versus two safe dynamic stops and retained setting.
comparison.reason: Shared rotation is only a generic primitive; relative in-air assembly clocking tests a different physical ability.
